	private bool VerifyTeamAffiliation(bl_AIShooter agent, Team team)

		{
			if (!(this.SpawningBots[j] == null) && !(this.SpawningBots[j].gameObject == null))
			{

	// Token: 0x06000160 RID: 352 RVA: 0x00014C58 File Offset: 0x00012E58
	public void ReplaceBotWithPlayer(Player newPlayer, Team playerTeam)
	{
		if (!this.BotsActive)
		{
			return;
		}
		string remplaceBot = string.Empty;
		List<bl_AIMananger.PlayersSlots> list = (playerTeam == Team.Team2) ? this.Team2PlayersSlots : this.Team1PlayersSlots;
		if (list.Exists((bl_AIMananger.PlayersSlots x) => x.Player == newPlayer.NickName))
		{
			return;
		}
		int num = list.FindIndex((bl_AIMananger.PlayersSlots x) => x.Player == string.Empty);
		if (num != -1)
		{
			remplaceBot = list[num].Bot;
			this.DeleteBot(remplaceBot);
			list[num].Player = newPlayer.NickName;
			list[num].Bot = string.Empty;
			if (bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient)
			{
				int num2 = (playerTeam == Team.Team2) ? 2 : 1;
				base.photonView.RPC("SyncBotStat", RpcTarget.Others, new object[]
				{
					string.Format("{0}|{1}", num2, newPlayer.NickName),
					num,
					4
				});
			}
			Debug.Log(string.Concat(new string[]
			{
				"<color=yellow>Bot ",
				remplaceBot,
				" was replaced by ",
				newPlayer.NickName,
				"</color>"
			}));
		}
		if (newPlayer.IsMasterClient && bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient && !this.isMasterAlredyInTeam && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(remplaceBot))
		{
			bl_AIShooter bl_AIShooter = this.AllBots.Find((bl_AIShooter x) => x.AIName == remplaceBot);
			if (bl_AIShooter != null)
			{
				Component component = bl_AIShooter.GetComponent<PhotonView>();
				bl_AIShooter.References.shooterHealth.DestroyEntity();
				this.AllBots.Remove(bl_AIShooter);
				this.AllBotsTransforms.Remove(bl_AIShooter.AimTarget);
				PhotonNetwork.Destroy(component.gameObject);
			}
			this.isMasterAlredyInTeam = true;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000161 RID: 353 RVA: 0x00014E54 File Offset: 0x00013054
	public void OnMasterClientSwitched(Player newMasterClient)

			if (this.Team1PlayersSlots == null || this.Team1PlayersSlots.Count <= 0)
			{
				this.SetUpSlots(false);

			{

				else

			}
		}
	}

				Team = bl_AIShooter.AITeam
			};

			feedData2.AddData("headshot", ishead);
			bl_KillFeedBase.Instance.SendKillMessageEvent(feedData2);

			{
				killer = bl_AIShooter;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.Log("Bot who kill this bot can't be found");
			}

		}

			}

			{

		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000705 RID: 1797 RVA: 0x00023550 File Offset: 0x00021750
	public void OnRemoteActorChange(bl_EventHandler.PlayerChangeData data)
	{
		int num = this.OthersActorsInScene.FindIndex((MFPSPlayer x) => x.Name == data.PlayerName);
		if (num != -1)
		{
			if (data.IsAlive)
			{
				if (data.MFPSActor != null)
				{
					this.OthersActorsInScene[num] = data.MFPSActor;
				}
				else
				{
					this.OthersActorsInScene[num].isAlive = data.IsAlive;
				}
				this.OthersActorsInScene[num].ActorView = data.NetworkView;
				return;
			}
			if (this.OthersActorsInScene[num].Actor == null)
			{
				this.OthersActorsInScene[num].isAlive = false;
				return;
			}
		}
		else if (data.IsAlive)
		{
			if (data.MFPSActor == null)
			{
				Debug.LogWarning("Actor data for " + data.PlayerName + " has not been build yet.");
				return;
			}
			if (data.MFPSActor.ActorView == null)
			{
				MFPSPlayer mfpsactor = data.MFPSActor;
				Transform actor = data.MFPSActor.Actor;
				mfpsactor.ActorView = ((actor != null) ? actor.GetComponent<PhotonView>() : null);
			}
			this.OthersActorsInScene.Add(data.MFPSActor);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000711 RID: 1809 RVA: 0x00023AD8 File Offset: 0x00021CD8
	private void CheckPlayersInMatch()
	{
		if (bl_MatchTimeManagerBase.Instance.IsInitialized || this.GameMatchState != MatchState.Waiting)
		{
			bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText("", false);
			return;
		}
		bool flag = false;
		if (base.isOneTeamMode)
		{
			flag = (PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length >= this.WaitingPlayersAmount);
		}
		else
		{
			int num = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.GetPlayersInTeam(Team.Team1).Length;
			int num2 = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.GetPlayersInTeam(Team.Team2).Length;
			int num3 = PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length;
			if (bl_AIMananger.Instance.BotsActive)
			{
				num3 += bl_AIMananger.Instance.BotsStatistics.Count;
				num += bl_AIMananger.Instance.GetAllBotsInTeam(Team.Team1).Count;
				num2 += bl_AIMananger.Instance.GetAllBotsInTeam(Team.Team2).Count;
			}
			if (num3 >= this.WaitingPlayersAmount)
			{
				if ((num <= 0 || num2 <= 0) && this.WaitingPlayersAmount > 1)
				{
					bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText(bl_Localization.Instance.GetText(128), true);
					return;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			if (bl_PhotonNetwork.IsMasterClient)
			{
				bl_MatchTimeManagerBase.Instance.InitAfterWaiting();
			}
			this.SetGameState(MatchState.Starting);
			bl_MatchTimeManagerBase.Instance.SetTimeState(RoomTimeState.Started, true);
			Action action = this.onAllPlayersRequiredIn;
			if (action != null)
			{
				action();
			}
			bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText("", false);
			return;
		}
		bl_UIReferences.Instance.SetWaitingPlayersText(string.Format(bl_GameTexts.WaitingPlayers, PhotonNetwork.PlayerList.Length, 2), true);
	}

	public void PickUpGun(GunPickUpData e)
	{
		if (bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.Instance == null)
		{
			Debug.LogWarning("Need a 'Pick Up Manager' in the scene!");
			return;
		}
		bl_Gun bl_Gun = this.AllGuns.Find((bl_Gun x) => x.GunID == e.ID);
		if (bl_Gun == null)
		{
			Debug.LogWarning(string.Format("The weapon {0} is not integrated in this player prefab.", e.ID));
			return;
		}
		if (!this.PlayerEquip.Exists((bl_Gun x) => x != null && x.GunID == e.ID))
		{
			bl_GunInfo weapon = bl_GameData.Instance.GetWeapon(e.ID);
			for (int i = 0; i < this.PlayerEquip.Count; i++)
			{
				if (this.PlayerEquip[i] == null && bl_GameData.Instance.weaponSlotRuler.CanBeOnSlot(weapon.Type, i))
				{
					this.SetUpPickUpWeapon(e, bl_Gun, i);
					if (this.EquipPickUpMode.IsEnumFlagPresent(bl_GunManager.AutoChangeOnPickup.OnlyOnEmptySlots))
					{
						base.StartCoroutine(this.SwitchToPickUpGun(null, bl_Gun, null, i));
						this.currentWeaponIndex = i;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			bool flag = this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex] == null;
			if (!flag)
			{
				int gunID = this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex].GunID;
			}
			int[] array = new int[2];
			int num = flag ? 3 : this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex].RemainingClips;
			array[0] = num;
			array[1] = (flag ? 30 : this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex].bulletsLeft);
			bl_Gun bl_Gun2;
			if (!bl_GameData.Instance.weaponSlotRuler.CanBeOnSlot(weapon.Type, this.currentWeaponIndex))
			{
				int j = 0;
				while (j < 4)
				{
					if (bl_GameData.Instance.weaponSlotRuler.CanBeOnSlot(weapon.Type, j))
					{
						bl_Gun2 = this.PlayerEquip[j];
						this.SetUpPickUpWeapon(e, bl_Gun, j);
						if (this.EquipPickUpMode == bl_GunManager.AutoChangeOnPickup.OnlyOnReplacements)
						{
							base.StartCoroutine(this.SwitchToPickUpGun(bl_Gun2, bl_Gun, array, j));
							this.currentWeaponIndex = j;
							return;
						}
						bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.Instance.ThrowGun(new bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.ThrowData
						{
							GunID = bl_Gun2.GunID,
							Origin = this.GetThrowPosition(),
							Direction = this.GetThrowDirection(),
							Data = array,
							AutoDestroy = false
						});
						return;
					}
					else
					{
						j++;
					}
				}
			}
			bl_Gun2 = this.PlayerEquip[this.currentWeaponIndex];
			this.SetUpPickUpWeapon(e, bl_Gun, this.currentWeaponIndex);
			base.StartCoroutine(this.SwitchToPickUpGun(bl_Gun2, bl_Gun, array, this.currentWeaponIndex));
			return;
		}
		foreach (bl_Gun bl_Gun3 in this.PlayerEquip)
		{
			if (bl_Gun3 != null && bl_Gun3.GunID == e.ID)
			{
				bl_Gun3.OnPickUpAmmo(e.Bullets * e.Clips, 1, e.ID);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C22 RID: 3106 RVA: 0x00032B44 File Offset: 0x00030D44
	private void SetUpPickUpWeapon(GunPickUpData data, bl_Gun gun, int slotID)
	{
		this.PlayerEquip[slotID] = gun;
		gun.Setup(true);
		if (gun.Info.Type == GunType.Grenade)
		{
			if (gun.bulletsLeft <= 0)
			{
				gun.bulletsLeft = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				int remainingClips = gun.RemainingClips;
				gun.RemainingClips = remainingClips + 1;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			gun.bulletsLeft = data.Bullets;
			gun.RemainingClips = data.Clips;
		}
		bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase instance = bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase.Instance;
		if (instance == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		instance.ReplaceSlot(slotID, gun);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C23 RID: 3107 RVA: 0x0000A82C File Offset: 0x00008A2C
	public IEnumerator SwitchToPickUpGun(bl_Gun currentGun, bl_Gun nextGun, int[] info, int newSlotID)
	{
		Animator headAnimator = this.HeadAnimator;
		if (headAnimator != null)
		{
			headAnimator.Play("TakeGun", 0, 0f);
		}
		if (currentGun != null)
		{
			currentGun.DisableWeapon(false);
		}
		if (this.currentWeaponIndex != newSlotID)
		{
			bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase instance = bl_WeaponLoadoutUIBase.Instance;
			if (instance != null)
			{
				instance.SetEquippedSlot(newSlotID);
			}
		}
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(this.PickUpTime);
		this.AllGuns.ForEach(delegate(bl_Gun x)
		{
			if (x != null)
			{
				x.gameObject.SetActive(false);
			}
		});
		this.TakeWeapon(nextGun, true);
		if (currentGun != null)
		{
			bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.Instance.ThrowGun(new bl_GunPickUpManagerBase.ThrowData
			{
				GunID = currentGun.GunID,
				Origin = this.GetThrowPosition(),
				Direction = this.GetThrowDirection(),
				Data = info,
				AutoDestroy = false
			});
		}
		bl_EventHandler.ChangeWeaponEvent(nextGun.GunID);
		bl_UIReferences.Instance.PlayerUI.WeaponStatsUI.SetActive(true);
		this.CanSwich = true;
		yield break;
	}

		array[0] = num;

		{

			Origin = throwPosition,
			Direction = base.transform.forward,
			Data = array,
			AutoDestroy = AutoDestroy

	// Token: 0x060005DA RID: 1498 RVA: 0x00020C84 File Offset: 0x0001EE84
	public void OnDisconnected(DisconnectCause cause)
	{
		if (cause == DisconnectCause.DisconnectByClientLogic)
		{
			if (this.quittingApp)
			{
				Debug.Log("Disconnect from Server!");
				return;
			}
			if (this.ServerRegionID == -1 && this.connectionState != LobbyConnectionState.Authenticating && PhotonNetwork.PhotonServerSettings.AppSettings.UseNameServer)
			{
				Debug.Log("Disconnect from cloud!");
			}
			else if (this.connectionState == LobbyConnectionState.ChangingRegion)
			{
				Debug.Log(string.Format("Changing server! region to: {0}", this.ServerRegionID));
				this.ConnectToServerRegion(this.ServerRegionID, false);
				bl_LobbyRoomListBase instance = bl_LobbyRoomListBase.Instance;
				if (instance == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				instance.ClearList();
				return;
			}
			else if (this.connectionState == LobbyConnectionState.Authenticating)
			{
				Debug.Log("Authentication complete, finishing connection...");
				bl_LobbyLoadingScreenBase.Instance.SetText("FINISHING UP...".Localized(198, false));
				if (!PhotonNetwork.PhotonServerSettings.AppSettings.UseNameServer)
				{
					this.ConnectPhoton();
					return;
				}
				PhotonNetwork.AuthValues = new AuthenticationValues(bl_PhotonNetwork.NickName);
				if (this.ServerRegionID == -1)
				{
					this.ConnectPhoton();
					return;
				}
				this.ConnectToServerRegion(this.ServerRegionID, false);
				return;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.Log("Disconnect from Server.");
			}
		}
		else
		{
			bl_LobbyUI.Instance.blackScreenFader.FadeOut(1f, null);
			bl_LobbyUI.Instance.connectionPopupMessage.SetConfirmationText("Try again".ToUpper());
			if (cause != DisconnectCause.CustomAuthenticationFailed)
			{
				bl_LobbyUI.Instance.connectionPopupMessage.AskConfirmation(string.Format(bl_GameTexts.DisconnectCause.Localized(41, false), cause.ToString()), delegate
				{
					this.ConnectPhoton();
					Debug.LogWarning("Failed to connect to server, cause: " + cause.ToString());
				}, null);
			}
		}
		this.connectionState = LobbyConnectionState.Disconnected;
	}

				{
					' ',
					','

			}

			{
				if (flag)

					this.chatClient.PrivateChannels.Remove(this.selectedChannelName);

					' ',
					','
				}, 2);
				if (array3.Length < 2)

				}
				string target2 = array3[0];
				string message = array3[1];
				this.chatClient.SendPrivateMessage(target2, message, false);
				return;
			}
			else
			{
				if ((!array[0].Equals("\\join") && !array[0].Equals("\\j")) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[1]))

	private void SyncDamage(int damage, string killer, DamageCause cause, Vector3 hitDirection, bool isHeatShot, int weaponID, Player m_sender)

			return;

						bl_DamageIndicatorBase instance = bl_DamageIndicatorBase.Instance;
						if (instance != null)

							instance.SetHit(hitDirection);

					bl_EventHandler.DispatchLocalPlayerHitEnemy(new MFPSHitData
					{
						HitTransform = base.transform,
						HitPosition = base.transform.position,
						Damage = damage,
						HitName = base.gameObject.name
					});
				}
			}
			if (cause != DamageCause.FallDamage && cause != DamageCause.Fire)
			{
				if (this.HitsSound.Length != 0)
				{
					AudioSource.PlayClipAtPoint(this.HitsSound[UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, this.HitsSound.Length)], base.transform.position, 1f);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AudioSource.PlayClipAtPoint(this.InjuredSounds[UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, this.InjuredSounds.Length)], base.transform.position, 1f);
			}
			this.lastDamageGiverActor = killer;
		}
		if (this.currentHealth > 0)
		{
			this.currentHealth -= damage;
			if (!base.isMine)
			{
				this.playerReferences.playerAnimations.OnGetHit();
			}

			{

	}

	private void Die(string killer, bool isHeadshot, DamageCause cause, int gunID, Vector3 hitPos, Player sender)

	public void AddKill(bool isHeadshot, string m_weapon, int gunID)
	{
		bl_KillFeedBase.FeedData feedData = new bl_KillFeedBase.FeedData

			RightText = base.gameObject.name,
			Team = bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer.GetPlayerTeam()

			KillMethod = m_weapon

		if (playerTeam != Team.All && playerTeam != bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer.GetPlayerTeam())
		{
			bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer.PostScore(scoreToAdd);
		}

	// Token: 0x060006A4 RID: 1700 RVA: 0x00022524 File Offset: 0x00020724
	[PunRPC]
	private void FireSync(GunType weaponType, Vector3 hitPosition, Vector3 inaccuracity)
	{
		if (this.CurrenGun == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		switch (weaponType)
		{
		case GunType.Shotgun:
		case GunType.Sniper:
		case GunType.Burst:
			this.CurrenGun.Fire(hitPosition, inaccuracity);
			return;
		case GunType.Machinegun:
			this.CurrenGun.Fire(hitPosition, inaccuracity);
			this.PlayerReferences.playerAnimations.PlayFireAnimation(GunType.Machinegun);
			return;
		case GunType.Pistol:
			this.CurrenGun.Fire(hitPosition, inaccuracity);
			this.PlayerReferences.playerAnimations.PlayFireAnimation(GunType.Pistol);
			return;
		case GunType.Knife:
			this.CurrenGun.KnifeFire();
			this.PlayerReferences.playerAnimations.PlayFireAnimation(GunType.Knife);
			return;
		}
		Debug.LogWarning("Not defined weapon type to sync bullets.");
	}

		}

	// Token: 0x0600158A RID: 5514
	private void DrawESP()
	{
		if (Camera.main == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (bl_GameManager.Instance == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (MFPSPlayer player in bl_GameManager.Instance.OthersActorsInScene)
		{
			if (!(player.Actor == null) && (!player.isRealPlayer || player.Team != bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer.GetPlayerTeam()))
			{
				bl_PlayerReferences component = player.Actor.GetComponent<bl_PlayerReferences>();
				Transform aimTarget = (component != null) ? component.BotAimTarget : null;
				if (!(aimTarget == null))
				{
					Vector3 worldPos = aimTarget.position;
					Vector3 screenPos = Camera.main.WorldToScreenPoint(worldPos);
					if (screenPos.z >= 0f)
					{
						float height = this.GetPlayerHeight(player.Actor);
						float width = height * 0.35f;
						Rect box = new Rect(screenPos.x - width / 2f, (float)Screen.height - screenPos.y - height, width, height);
						this.DrawBox(box, 2f, Color.red);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		foreach (bl_AIShooter bot in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<bl_AIShooter>())
		{
			if (!(bot == null) && !bot.isDeath && bot.AITeam != bl_PhotonNetwork.LocalPlayer.GetPlayerTeam())
			{
				Transform aimTarget2 = bot.AimTarget;
				if (aimTarget2 == null)
				{
					aimTarget2 = bot.transform;
				}
				Vector3 worldPos2 = aimTarget2.position;
				Vector3 screenPos2 = Camera.main.WorldToScreenPoint(worldPos2);
				if (screenPos2.z >= 0f)
				{
					float height2 = this.GetBotHeight(bot);
					float width2 = height2 * 0.35f;
					Rect box2 = new Rect(screenPos2.x - width2 / 2f, (float)Screen.height - screenPos2.y - height2, width2, height2);
					this.DrawBox(box2, 2f, Color.yellow);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600158B RID: 5515
	private float GetPlayerHeight(Transform actor)
	{
		bl_PlayerReferences refs = actor.GetComponent<bl_PlayerReferences>();
		if (refs != null && refs.characterController != null)
		{
			return refs.characterController.height * 0.9f;
		}
		return 1.8f;
	}

	// Token: 0x0600158C RID: 5516
	private float GetBotHeight(bl_AIShooter bot)
	{
		if (bot.References != null)
		{
			CharacterController cc = bot.References.GetComponent<CharacterController>();
			if (cc != null)
			{
				return cc.height * 0.9f;
			}
			CapsuleCollider col = bot.References.GetComponent<CapsuleCollider>();
			if (col != null)
			{
				return col.height * 0.9f;
			}
		}
		CapsuleCollider col2 = bot.GetComponent<CapsuleCollider>();
		if (col2 != null)
		{
			return col2.height * 0.9f;
		}
		return 1.7f;
	}

		GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, thickness), tex);
		GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(rect.x, rect.y + rect.height - thickness, rect.width, thickness), tex);
		GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(rect.x, rect.y, thickness, rect.height), tex);
		GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(rect.x + rect.width - thickness, rect.y, thickness, rect.height), tex);
	}
